title: Deferred readouts on PR117’s complex producer: conditional κ = 1.085428e-4
body:
**Audit correction:** the inherited unit-coefficient check failed on 55/42. This update implements and verifies an exact split into at most two unit-magnitude shears at the same frame. The independent audit now passes, charging 11,862,944 unit shears for 11,862,912 nonzero old readout coefficients (32 extra additions). The conservative scalar guard is doubled and recertified; the complete child profile and κ are unchanged. Eight controls reject missing, oversized and incorrectly signed pieces. The original failure is preserved in the validation evidence. Combined coverage is now complete; the original failed invocation remains disclosed below.

**Verification completed:** Combined verification passed. The original full invocation on `ec862a5af51537495c745d9f2323e8a5736ee265` passed `make -j1 verify`, producer, bit and certificate commands, then failed the inherited unit-coefficient audit; its sixth planned equality command did not run. The corrected `verify.py --full` passed on `6ec868e8568ca9a74b7245494de1b187c7be78fe` in 303.50 seconds, including exact regenerated artifacts, pins, eight controls and the paid unit-shear reflected audit. The broad sources and physical producer/DAG/profiles are byte-identical across these commits, and both runs had no source drift. All 42 corrected-head GitHub checks passed. This is combined coverage, not a monolithic full-make run on the corrected commit. See `research/deferred-replayed-117/validation.json`.

Conditional κ = 6783925373/(6.25·10^13) = **1.085428059680×10⁻⁴**, **+3.875% over #117** (1044939/10^10), +9.97% over #116.

#117 found an h=24 all-disjoint complex DAG with only 28,705 roles, but charged it with #104's plain profile; its complex saving 26129/(2.5·10^8) binds. #110/#114/#116 showed deferred readouts pay on the complex network under #104's one-child rule. This PR runs the same deferral algorithm, with the producer adapter, expected graph counts and pair-star root ordering updated on #117's replayed DAG.

| h=24 complex | #117 | this |
|---|---:|---:|
| roles | 28,705 | 28,705 (same DAG) |
| deferred roles | — | 3,020 |
| complex saving (binding) | 1.045160e-4 | **1.085665e-4** (108566486/10^12) |
| κ | 1.044939e-4 | **1.085428e-4** |

Bit side unchanged: Swapnil Jain's round-seven deferred word, one-child rule (same as #117 and #110/#116).

Checks: `complex_deferred.py` (DAG replay via #117's unchanged `replayed.py`, maximum carrier matching, lifted frames, deferral, arbitrary-scratch replay, exact F2 checks; pins 91,770/8,120/71,185/28,705) and `certificate.py` (#116's exact certificate: moments, next-grid rejections, expanded scalar charge, 47 constraints, 7 margins; requires κ above #117 and #116).

Credit: eumemic (#117, #114), Avi Eisenberg (#110), Swapnil Jain, icekylinx (#104/#115), #116 and all predecessors. Composition by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance.

Independent local cross-check: a separately adapted PR116 deferral run on pinned PR117 head `cbb05ce504d571546d9b7794c186a613c659c3bf` passed and reproduced both the complete complex profile and exact certificate in this branch exactly. The corrected independent reflected-word audit passed, including exact dirty cancellation, all frame incidences and the complete child histogram. The original broad run and corrected package replay are documented in the combined validation receipt. All inherited analytic, fixed-tape, stopped-product and residual-to-child interfaces remain conditional assumptions.
